description: This file defines utility functions and a class for creating and managing a search index for admin console sections and plugin entries in the Mattermost web application. It includes functions to extract text from admin sections, generate a searchable index, and add entries to the index.

methods.name: pushText
methods.description: Adds a string or formatted message to the texts array based on the value type.

methods.name: extractTextsFromSection
methods.description: Extracts searchable text from an admin console section, including title, name, searchable strings, and settings.

methods.name: extractTextFromSettings
methods.description: Extracts searchable text from admin console settings.

methods.name: adminDefinitionsToUrlsAndTexts
methods.description: Converts admin definitions into a mapping of URLs to searchable texts.

methods.name: generateIndex
methods.description: Creates a FlexSearch index with admin console sections and plugin entries.

methods.name: addToIndex
methods.description: Adds entries to the search index by concatenating their texts.
